effects.text: Whenever a card is destroyed by an effect on a negative card or in a purge, you may mark 1 {mark} here instead.

4.helpText:
VERSION NOTE: The Garrisoned Border no longer gives 5 fame and also is destroyed when using it a second time.

Note that this effect also applies during a purge. If you use it to prevent a card from being purged, you do not get the [vp] from that card during the purge.
